items.title: Week ahead: US inflation and retail sales lead a busy economic calendar. Be aware.
items.summary: Next week starts quietly, but it does not stay that way. The economic calendar gets going on Wednesday with the US CPI report, followed by Australian employment that evening. Thursday brings UK GDP before a busy 8:30 AM window in the US, with producer prices, retail sales, jobless claims and the Philadelphia Fed manufacturing index all released at the same…
